title: Ontology Proposal v1.0.0
description: Proposed ontology relation. Evidence-backed but non-canonical. Subject and object are packet_keys. Promotion to canonical requires authorization gate.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Breaking changes increment major.

proposalId.description: UUIDv7 unique identifier for this proposal.

subjectPacketKey.description: packet_key of subject (source) packet. Must exist in atlas_packets.

predicate.description: Relation type. Controlled vocabulary for ontology consistency.

objectPacketKey.description: packet_key of object (target) packet. Must exist in atlas_packets.

confidence.description: Proposer confidence in this relation (0-1). Evidence of how certain the proposer is.

evidenceIds.description: References to supporting evidence (packet_keys of evidence packets, or UUIDs of extraction results). Explains why this relation was proposed.

proposalSource.description: How this relation was proposed (automated or manual).

ontologyVersion.description: Ontology schema version at proposal time (e.g., 'atlas:ontology:v4'). Proposal may become invalid if ontology changes.

status.description: Lifecycle. PROPOSED = awaiting review. GATED_* = awaiting gates. ACCEPTED = approved for canonical. APPROVED = promoted to atlas_ontology. DEPRECATED = replaced.

gateReason.description: If status starts with GATED_, reason why (e.g., 'confidence < 0.7', 'subject packet unresolved')

approvedBy.description: User or service that approved promotion from ACCEPTED to canonical. NULL if not yet approved.

approvedAt.description: Timestamp of approval. NULL if not yet approved.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when proposal was created.

metadata.description: Extensible metadata. Proposer-specific reasoning, confidence breakdown, etc. NOT part of canonical ontology.
